rating.comments: The first student message 'hey there boyy' is greeting text and the second message restates the task question, so neither is scored as reasoning. Later student messages 'i dont know any of that data can u please make some sort of interest' and 'make some sort of estimate' only ask the AI to do the work, and 'oi did u not hear what i said' is a complaint. These give no reasons, do not build on earlier content, and ask no content question. Effort is rated 2 because the student sent fragmentary replies that hand the work back, with no complete attempt.
